test_title: PYST 65: SSC CGL 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Simplify (sin A)/(1 + cos A) + cotA, where A is an acute angle.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Put A = 30° in the given expression to quickly find the answer.

⇒ sin 30° / (1 + cos 30°) + cot 30°

⇒ (1 / 2) / (1 + √3 / 2) + √3

⇒ 1 / (2 + √3) + √3 = (2 − √3) + √3 = 2

Checking the given options for A = 30°, we get cosec 30° = 2.

**∴ The correct answer is cosec A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = sin A / (1 + cos A) + cot A

**Formula Used:**

⇒ cot A = cos A / sin A

⇒ sin² A + cos² A = 1

**Calculations:**

⇒ Expression = sin A / (1 + cos A) + (cos A / sin A)

⇒ Taking the LCM of the denominators:

⇒ Expression = [sin² A + cos A × (1 + cos A)] / [sin A × (1 + cos A)]

⇒ Expression = [sin² A + cos A + cos² A] / [sin A × (1 + cos A)]

⇒ Grouping the squared terms together:

⇒ Expression = [(sin² A + cos² A) + cos A] / [sin A × (1 + cos A)]

⇒ Expression = (1 + cos A) / [sin A × (1 + cos A)]

⇒ Expression = 1 / sin A

⇒ Expression = cosec A

**∴ The correct answer is cosec A.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Trigonometric Identities

• sin² θ + cos² θ = 1
• 1 + tan² θ = sec² θ
• 1 + cot² θ = cosec² θ

Reciprocal Relations

• sin θ × cosec θ = 1
• cos θ × sec θ = 1
• tan θ × cot θ = 1

Half Angle Concept

The term sin A / (1 + cos A) directly simplifies to tan(A / 2). Understanding these relations can help save time during exam simplification problems.
